11.t: The following Dip Switches for Loco-Motion are found on both the C.P.U. and Logic Board, and the Sound Board. The settings below are a guide in selecting optional game format.
DIP SWITCH 1
sw. 1 SW. 2 SW. 3 sw. 4 COIN/PLAY OPTIONS
off   off   off   off   1 Coin, 1 Play
off   Off   Off   on   1 Coin, 2 Plays
off   Off   On   Off   1 Coin, 3 Plays
off   off   on   on   1 Coin, 4 Plays
Off   On   off   Off   1 Coin, 5 Plays
Off   on   Off   On   1 Coin, 6 Plays
off   On   on   off   1 Coin, 7 Plays
off   on   On   On   2 Coins, 1 Play
on   off   off   off   2 Coins, 3 Plays
On   Off   oft   On   2 Coins, 5 Plays
on   off   on   off   3 Coins, 1 Play
On   off   on   On   3 Coins, 2 Plays
on   on   off   off   3 Coins, 4 Plays
On   on   off   on   4 Coins, 1 Play
on   On   On   Off   4 Coins, 3 Plays
On   On   On   On   FREE PLAY
DIP SWITCH 2
SWITCH 1   SWITCH 2   NUMBER OF TRAINS
Off   oft   Three (3)
off   on   Four (4)
on   off   Five (5)
On   On   Two Hundred-Fifty Five (255)
SWITCH 3 GAME CABINET VERSION
Off Cocktail Table On Upright Cabinet SWITCH 4 has no assigned function.
SWITCH 5 - Off position Attract Mode is on
- On position, no Attract Mode
SWITCH 6 - On, Sound along with Attract Mode Off, no sound in Attract Mode
